\expertauditsection{Reactions from the audit of the equivalence metric}
\label{app:metric_audit_cases}

This appendix shows reactions from the audit of the equivalence metric by a chemistry annotator (Appendix~\ref{app:equiv_acc_metric}). Table~\ref{tab:metric_audit_cases} lists the annotator judgement for all 20 audited SynRBL completions and the label assigned by the revised metric. For each judgement except uncertain, we show the case with the highest annotator confidence, with ties broken by the lowest case number (Figures~\ref{fig:metric_audit_case_4}--\ref{fig:metric_audit_case_8}). The two cases judged uncertain appear only in the table. Figures of all 20 cases are provided in the code repository. Each figure shows the USPTO input, the FlowER target and the SynRBL completion, drawn at the same scale. Shading marks molecules that differ between the target and the completion.
